To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in. That is the pitch fee, rates and water and the gas safety check in March. Split four ways the same as always, that's £1,271.75 each.

It has gone up again, nearly £350 on last year. I know it's a lot but there's nothing I can do about it, the park sets it.

Please can you pay me by 31 January into the usual account, same as before. The park wants it all by then so I can't really go past that date. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine. Make it £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January, which comes to the same.

The weeks for 2027. Everyone has asked for something different so there are no clashes this year.

Carol, Easter week and a week in September. Just let me know which September week you want.
Pete and Linda, May half term, 29 May to 5 June.
Me and Bev, 5 to 12 June. Pete, that's a same day handover on the 5th.
Jan, second week of August, 7th to 14th.

Pete, you mentioned the shower tray was cracked. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It was £140 in parts but I've not put it on the bill, it's done now.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned at us about it again.

Also so nobody gets a surprise later on, the park says any caravan over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 year old now so we will have to have it done. I'll find out more about it and let you know nearer the time.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
